% typesetting pass. Equivalent to colorlinks=false + pdfborder={0 0 0}.

% ANONYMOUS SUBMISSION SOURCE (IEEE TAI, double-anonymous review). This file

% disclosure) lives in CAMERA-READY-NOTES.md and is pasted in ONLY after
% acceptance.
\newcommand{\jrnlname}{IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence}

% Validate exactly one toggle is true via a counter, NOT via nested
% \iftnnls/\iftaslp branches: writing the bare conditional names as text
% inside an \iftnnls/\iftaslp branch (even through \string) is a classic TeX
% trap -- TeX's conditional-skipping scanner recognizes those tokens by their
% *current meaning* even when "just quoted," which miscounts \if/\fi nesting
% and can silently swallow a later \fi. A plain counter has no such hazard.
\makeatletter
\newcount\@venuecount
\@venuecount=0
\iftnnls\advance\@venuecount by 1\relax\fi
\iftaslp\advance\@venuecount by 1\relax\fi
\ifnum\@venuecount=1\relax\else
  \PackageError{venue-fork}{Exactly one venue toggle must be true}{Set exactly one of the two venue booleans (tnnls / taslp) true near the top of main.tex; currently \number\@venuecount\space are true.}
\fi
\makeatother
